_meta.definition: Rule-35 entry holds. A ticker listed here may not ENTER the portfolio while its hold is live (expires is inclusive; a missing or unreadable expiry fails closed). Holds never affect scores, ranks, or names already held. Human-written in the session that writes the briefing recording the event; the scripts never edit this file.
_meta.when_to_add: The context briefing records an unresolved event the score cannot see: a new government enforcement action, a securities case filed in the last 90 days, a guidance cut, or a transformative transaction announced since the last reported quarter.
_meta.expiry: A set date, normally just after the next earnings report or other resolving event. An expired hold is simply inactive; replace or remove the entry when re-ruling.
